methodology: Likes combine the existing expert prefill with the 16 value and sleeper candidates reviewed and approved on August 20. Avoids are players whose current expert rank materially trails ADP, who were identified as price-sensitive fades, or who the user explicitly placed on the shared avoid list. These are editable research starting points, not permanent labels.
